# W22 Alerts (lean, 18 Oct 2026)

**Workflow:** `automation/W22.json`, generated by `automation/build-w22.mjs` · **Logic:** `automation/lib/w22.mjs` · **Test:** `node --test automation/tests/W22.test.mjs`

Jono's scope (18 Oct 2026): n8n failures and workflow signals, 24 h dedupe, WhatsApp to him through the Twilio sender, email through the SortMyCover relay. No ops schema.

The earlier design (ops.notifications / ops.w22_metrics, DND, the 2 h / 4 h escalation ladder, threshold sweep, hourly probes) needed tables the CRM does not have (those migrations are parked under the one-hub rule). It is in git history before this file changed.

## 1. In
- **n8n Error Trigger.** Every SMC workflow names `smc-w22` as its error workflow (`settings.errorWorkflow`; checked by the W22 test).
- **Signals from other workflows** (Execute Workflow `smc-w22`, one item per signal). Shapes accepted (`lib/w22.mjs normalise()`):
  - own shape `{ signal_key, scope, severity: red|amber, what, impact, first_action, source, since }` (W05, W06, SUB-whatsapp-send, W20, W27, W28, W30, W31 …); registered keys get defaults from `PRODUCER_SIGNALS`;
  - W34 shape `{ kind, severity: red|amber|info, message, deep_link, dsr_id | incident_id | to_broker_id }`;
  - raw Meta WhatsApp changes (`message_template_status_update` REJECTED/PAUSED/DISABLED/FLAGGED, `phone_number_quality_update`, `account_update`) and Paystack failures (`invoice.payment_failed`, `charge.failed`, `subscription.not_renew`);
  - `{ type: 'ack' }` is ignored; anything unreadable becomes an amber `unknown_signal` (nothing is dropped silently).

## 2. Rules
- **Severity.** A failed lead or booking workflow (W01-W07, W09, W10, W15, W28, WhatsApp Send, Email Verify) is red; any other failure is amber. Signals keep their own severity (`info` = amber).
- **Dedupe.** At most one alert per `signal_key|scope|severity` per 24 h, kept in the workflow's static data. A failure's scope is `workflow:<id>:<node>`, so a different failing node is a new alert.
- **No PII.** Emails, SA phone numbers and SA ID numbers are masked in every field (`redact()`).

## 3. Out
| Channel | When | How |
|---|---|---|
| Email | every alert | `smc-email-send` (Resend, `SortMyCover <hello@sortmycover.co.za>`) to `OPS_ALERT_EMAIL`, gated by `DRY_RUN_SENDS` |
| WhatsApp | **every alert, red and amber** (owner rule, 24 Oct 2026: every SortMyCover notification is a WhatsApp to Jono from the SMC number) | `lib/owner-alert.mjs` items through `smc-whatsapp-send` to the owner number (`SMC_OWNER_WHATSAPP`, else `OPS_WHATSAPP_JONATHAN`, else the documented default) and `OPS_WHATSAPP_KG` for `to: both` / `kg`; template `ops_update` once `TWILIO_CONTENT_SIDS` has its SID, else the approved `ops_alert`; no SID at all -> email only. Variables: `[ 'Jono' \| 'KG', 'Red alert: <what>' \| 'Alert: <what>', <impact \| first action> ]`, redacted, no newlines. `record: false`, `bypass_suppression: true` (Jono's number is also a test lead) |

Email-only, whatever the severity: a synthetic signal (`synthetic: true`, SYNTHETIC_TEST_NUMBERS), the sender's own
`whatsapp_send_failed` (`EMAIL_ONLY_SIGNALS`) and an n8n failure of the sender workflow itself (Error Trigger scope
`workflow:smc-whatsapp-send:...`, `emailOnly()`): W22 cannot loop on WhatsApp. The 24-h dedupe keeps amber volume down.

## 4. Env
`OPS_ALERT_EMAIL`, `SMC_OWNER_WHATSAPP` (optional; Zoe Experience later), `OPS_WHATSAPP_JONATHAN`, `OPS_WHATSAPP_KG` (optional), `TWILIO_CONTENT_SIDS` (`ops_update` and/or `ops_alert`), `LINDI_RELAY_TOKEN`, `SUPABASE_FUNCTIONS_URL` (optional), `DRY_RUN_SENDS`.

## 5. Producer contract
Call W22 with **Execute Workflow** (source database, workflow `smc-w22`, do not wait), one item per signal:

```json
{"signal_key":"client_email_failed","scope":"booking:<id>","severity":"amber",
 "what":"Client booking email failed","impact":"The client has no email copy of the booking",
 "first_action":"Check the Resend log","source":"W05"}
```
